established: Arbitrary signed exact-3SAT is exactly CSP(T_3SAT) for one fixed two-element target with eight ternary signed-clause relations, each containing seven Boolean tuples.
Exact projection of one complete source variable path in the two-path XOR/AND overlay is classical Davis-Putnam elimination, with polynomial witness reconstruction; it is not a new global quotient.
Current variable occurrence degree at most three is an exact polynomial Davis-Putnam preprocessing island because raw cross-polarity resolvents are fewer than removed incident clauses.
A mandatory source-incidence C4 is not universally available on a hard source class.
By deterministic Sparse Incomparability specialized to T_3SAT, for every fixed g there is a polynomial SAT-preserving reduction to signed-3SAT source structures of relational girth greater than g.
Therefore no finite catalogue of fixed bounded-length source alternating cycles can be the mandatory universal progress trigger.

The row-basis multiplicity-three router improves the exact universal exponential bound but remains secondary because the hard EQ3 image forces linear multiplicity-three coupling for every actual-row rational basis.
